name: 3812-ui-boot
about: ju-boot asks for CoinCounter from start and again each frame while it has no live screen: open is LUMA_E_BUSY (Ui.NoScene) until a scene runs with the system archive's fonts, never a screen on the boot font (no digits, deleted when the file fonts are made: a crash at its next draw); on the stage its screen is live and reads 1230, no Ui.NoGlyph (picture f100: a second coin counter reading 1230)
